scope: Primary PostgreSQL 18 semantics plus measured pinned PostgreSQL 18.6 local controls; no provider/price/patch selection

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 GRANT
sources.supports: Distinct ADMIN/SET/INHERIT options; grant options and recorded grantors; measured grantor controls use separate roles, not a policy exception.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES
sources.supports: Global and schema-scoped future-object privileges; actual zero-cardinality rows are established by this local SQL experiment, not inferred from documentation.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 CREATE INDEX
sources.supports: A failed concurrent unique-index build can leave an invalid index. The proof observes actual 23505 and pg_index state; no direct catalog writes.
